title: Introducing the Enhanced Spyglass
summary: We're thrilled to announce the official launch of the enhanced Spyglass, meticulously refined and ready to empower you with its full suite of powerful capabilities.

title: Unlock Powerful File Management and Display Options
summary: Effortlessly manage your files with new options to upload, remove, download, and customize how images and documents appear within your content.

summary: We've significantly upgraded our collaboration features, making it easier and more intuitive for your team to work together in real time.

title: Flexible Views for Your Connected Content
